address: Villa La Coste, 2750 route de la Cride, Le Puy-Sainte-Réparade, 13610, France
bio: In the heart of the Chateau La Coste estate, Louison embodies a rare combination of wine, architecture and contemporary art. In a clean-cut, glazed extension of Villa La Coste, the restaurant helmed by chef Florent Pietravalle unveils a lineup that is emblematic of his Mediterranean roots: expressive recipes depicted by surf-turf combinations and a distinct weakness for bitter notes. The chef’s distinctive signature can be tasted in each dish, which is a masterpiece of meticulous handiwork. Local produce, the harvest from the kitchen garden and olive oil from the estate take pride of place on the menu. The slick, flawless service is quite the equal of the decadent setting.
